Villa in Cherng Talay
HomeNew ProjectsThe Title Villa Kirara

Project overview

Villa Kirara is a pool-villa enclave by The Title Residence, offered in five plan types (Aura, Selene, Lyra, Myrrah, Xenia) with 360-degree virtual tours. The developer's site reports construction progress at 15.03% as of October 2026, with piling complete.
